changes.title: 60 upgrade scrolls now contribute 20 percent to new-run scores
changes.text: Owner-approved provisional score multiplier for 60 upgrade scrolls is now 0.20x rather than 0.5608735153608649x. This changes only one of the 357 lookup values for newly created runs: other settings, the 1 to 60 scroll count and generated scrolls stay unchanged. Original SPD score categories, challenge factors, score calculation once and gameplay RNG are preserved.

changes.title: Old runs keep their frozen scoring authority and accurate current-run display
changes.text: New runs freeze a distinct scoring calculation version; previously started runs retain the original 60-scroll factor and earned scores through save, ranking and recorded statistics. Viewing a locked existing run now uses its own saved scoring authority rather than next-run previews, including the exact per-slider description. No historical rerating or save format migration.

changes.title: Regress exact lookup values and historical saved scores
changes.text: Retained all 357 original authoritative reference decimals as historical verification and checked every new-position factor, with only 60 scrolls changed. Tests cover correct 59-scroll value, 15-scroll neutral, frozen old versus new run payout, version mismatch protection, current-run descriptions and every original UIMSD window regression. Exact full core-only run39826048570 passed 2049 tests in 397 suites, zero failures/errors/skips; earlier source fixture had one wrong expected 59-scroll value, now corrected.
